import io,json,os,sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.environ['WB_SCRIPTS'])
WB = os.environ['WB_HOME']
import diff_sandbox_check as ds
import tempfile, shutil, json
tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='wb-conn-');
try:
    r = ds.check(['src/**'], ['src/x.py'], allow_write=['src/**'],
                 deny=['.workbench/spec/**'],
                 deny_absolute_prefix=['C:/Windows'])
    print(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False))
    assert r['ok'], 'real: 允许路径被误拒'
    print('OK')
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
